info.name: AI GitHub Repository Assistant - Module 2
info.description: Covers the GitHub Repository Analyzer endpoint added in Module 2. The /api/github/analyze endpoint requires authentication, so a Login request is included first to establish the session cookie in Postman's cookie jar before calling Analyze.

request.description: Sets the httpOnly agra_token cookie in Postman's cookie jar, which the Analyze request below relies on.

Requires authentication (cookie set by the Login request). Fetches repository metadata + README from the GitHub REST API, then sends it to the local Ollama model (llama3.2:3b) for structured analysis.
